rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a hostile person, opposing group, or enemy force.

example.jyutping: go2 deoi6 jan4 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 dik6 jan4

rows.note: Choose this shorter form mainly in compact, formal, or written expressions for an opposing person or force.

example.english: The enemy force has already retreated.
example.jyutping: dik6 gwan1 ji5 ging1 cit3 teoi3

rows.note: Choose this for a bitter, sworn, or particularly hated enemy rather than an ordinary opponent.

example.english: They regard our family as their sworn enemy.
example.traditional: 佢哋視我哋一家為仇敵。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 si6 ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 wai4 sau4 dik6

rows.note: Use this for a major harmful or threatening thing, especially in expressions such as a serious enemy of health.

example.english: Staying up late is a major enemy of health.
example.jyutping: ngou4 je6 hai6 gin6 hong1 ge3 daai6 dik6
